generation.scope: The generic fifteen-dimensional asymmetric center has only isolated singularities and admits smooth polarized quartic K3 sections. Its twenty known (one,three) nodes cannot exhaust the singular locus, by periodic cyclic Euler localization on the four-object exceptional category. Additional (two,two,two,two) simples exist in finite number projectively. If all additional points are two-simple ordinary nodes there are exactly ten of them.
